author: Smoochoo
quote:
I have been playing this franchise since GTA 1 on Game Boy came out. I always loved and genuinely looked forward to it.
Now, I expected so much more after 13 years.
The game is full of bugs and glitches, which I have gotten used to in recent years, but I expected more from Rockstar and GTA 6.
There is nothing worth being called funny in this game. Been playing for 40 hours and have yet to laugh once. In comparison to GTA 5, that's a real downgrade. GTA 6 is just full of Gen Z content, that most people don't even think falls into the category of funny.
You can't even steal cars in your area, which...I mean, it's called Grand Theft Auto for a reason!?
The controls are horribly sluggish, as was expected from 30 fps but they couldn't even hold that promise, since in some situations I had low 20 fps.
You are stuck doing tedious relationship stuff for hours to keep your relationship going. I have a wife, I'd rather do that for her than for a poroly animated, ugly, male-looking character, with an insufferable personality. It seems Rockstar wanted to make a girl boss game. Mission accomplished. Pair that with the submissive beta male they call Jason and you get...I don't know what. All I can say is this is not GTA. GTA doesn't make you drywall in a way no one ever drywalled in real life, buy groceries, paint, massage feet and build IKEA furniture just to progress the game.
Enough said about the story, which in my view is a complete failure. Onto the graphics; I don't know about others, but I expected a way bigger graphical leap than what they delivered. I also don't see that improving more when it comes to PC. It just looks like GTA 5 but sligthly better.
I guess my question is what has Rockstar been doing for 13 years? Was the goal to piggyback entirely on the goodwill GTA 5 and GTA online established over the years?
And all that screeching about realism. Gamers never wanted realism in games. We play games to have an escape from reality. But when you actually wanna deliver something realistic, then atleast see it through, i.e. disappering airplanes, one handed shotgun, drywalling, furniture assembly and so on. 
What I really woulda loved was a return to player agency, i.e. if you find Lucia utterly insufferable, ignore her, kill her, get antoher girlfriend, and so on.
So, if you want a dating simulator, go for it. If you want a GTA game, I don't know what to tell you...hope they don't take another decade or abandon the story experience of GTA and do a better job next time around? As for me, this has soured me on Rockstar. 
I wish I could get my money back but since it's Playstation I guess I have to be happy with posting my honest thoughts about the game and take the loss.

author: Smoochoo
quote: Now, I had high hopes for this game, only to be disappointed by the execution. The original was a masterpiece. This however, let's start with the uglified characters, the added dialogue and to finish we get less fluid movement than we had over ten years ago. Can't recommend this game.

author: Smoochoo
quote: I don't even understand how this is can be considered a game. It's a visual light novel with an 80s soundtrack at best. The graphics look so dated, the cassette tapes aren't even made right in game that calls itself "mixtape". The characters aren't even moving fluidly. All in all, not recommended.

author: Smoochoo
quote:
Honestly, that game is extremely bright making it look just like any other UE5 game.
The story is bland at best, utterly disappointing. The characters look, well extremely ugly, like deliberately de-beautified, nothing like the characters in their other games.
While the puzzles are enjoyable, since there isn't much hand holding, the UI and controls are extremely frustrating. All in all, even if they fix the UI and controls, a bland story for a RPG is literally a death sentence for me. Pair that with the generic UE5 look and it is basically a failure for me.
